name: Kyonyuu Jukujo Kyoushi ~Furyou ni Yarareta Arafor Haha to Gakuen no Idol~
original_name: 巨乳熟女教師 ～不良にヤられたアラフォー母と学園のアイドル～
source:
Saeko is the strict teacher of the school, and her daughter Yukina, is the school idol loved by everyone.

Aiming for those two is the school delinquent Shin, who sets up a cowardly trap that would make the two of them go to the limits of lust.

Love is shattered, bonds are broken, and the school changes into a prison full of lust!
translation:
纱惠子是学校严格的老师，而她的女儿雪菜则是人人喜爱的学校偶像。

以这两人为目标的是学园不良少年申，他设置了一个懦弱的陷阱，让两人陷入情欲的极限。

爱情破碎，羁绊断裂，学校变成了充满情欲的监狱！
